verdict.rationale: Kick supports automation via Rules that trigger automatically on matching transaction syncs (kick-docs-7, kick-docs-18) and via MCP/CLI that can 'automate month-end checks' and 'build workflows that run across every workspace' (kick-docs-15). This is real automation depth, but it's event-triggered (on transaction sync) rather than documented as time-based recurring/scheduled job execution (e.g., no cron-style scheduler, no 'run every X days' config is shown). Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron mechanism for recurring workflows, documentation of how MCP-driven workflows are triggered on a recurring cadence, and independent confirmation of month-end automation working as scheduled.
